summary: Iteration 56: Tested scheduled email campaigns feature. Backend: 15/15 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All 12 test steps passed (100%). The feature correctly allows admins to schedule campaigns with target selection, cancel scheduled campaigns, delete campaigns, and view campaign status/history in the dashboard.

backend_tests: test_schedule_campaign_success - PASS - POST /api/admin/campaigns/schedule creates campaign with status 'scheduled'
test_list_campaigns_success - PASS - GET /api/admin/campaigns returns campaigns array
test_cancel_scheduled_campaign_success - PASS - PUT /api/admin/campaigns/{id}/cancel changes status to 'cancelled'
test_cancel_non_scheduled_campaign_returns_400 - PASS - Returns 400 for already cancelled campaign
test_campaign_has_all_required_fields - PASS - Campaign contains id, template_id, template_name, template_label, scheduled_at, target, status, recipients_count, sent_count, failed_count, created_at
test_campaign_valid_statuses - PASS - Campaigns only have valid status values (scheduled, executing, sent, cancelled, failed)
frontend_tests: Verify schedule buttons on all templates (schedule-btn-rassurant, schedule-btn-incitatif, schedule-btn-urgent) - PASS - All 3 found
Click schedule button on 'Ton rassurant' - PASS
Verify dialog elements (date-input, time-input, target-select, confirm-schedule-btn, info-message) - PASS - All found
Verify date prefilled to tomorrow, time to 09:00 - PASS
Click 'Programmer' button - PASS - Dialog closed, success toast shown
Verify campaigns dashboard shows campaign with 'Programmé' status - PASS
Test cancel campaign - PASS - Confirmation dialog opened, campaign status changed to 'Annulé'
Verify previous features still work (preview, send test, edit, duplicate, delete buttons) - PASS

critical_code_review_comments: Backend POST /api/admin/campaigns/schedule validates template exists, date is in future, and optionally validates A/B test
Backend _campaign_scheduler() background task runs every 60s checking for due campaigns
Backend _execute_campaign() properly sends emails using Resend with variable resolution
Frontend openSchedule() prefills date to tomorrow and time to 09:00, fetches active A/B tests
Frontend scheduleCampaign() constructs ISO datetime and calls API, handles success/error
Frontend CampaignsDashboard component fetches campaigns, shows status badges with correct colors
Campaign status badges use correct colors: scheduled=amber, cancelled=gray, sent=green, executing=blue, failed=red
Delete button only shown for cancelled/sent/failed campaigns, cancel button only for scheduled
seed_data_creation: Created test campaigns during testing which were cleaned up
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 56 verified scheduled email campaigns feature. Key endpoints: POST /api/admin/campaigns/schedule (creates campaign), GET /api/admin/campaigns (lists campaigns), PUT /api/admin/campaigns/{id}/cancel (cancels), DELETE /api/admin/campaigns/{id} (deletes). Frontend data-testids: schedule-btn-{templatename}, schedule-campaign-dialog, schedule-date-input, schedule-time-input, schedule-target-select, schedule-ab-select (if active AB tests exist), confirm-schedule-btn, campaigns-dashboard, campaign-row-{id}, cancel-campaign-{id}, delete-campaign-{id}, cancel-campaign-dialog, confirm-cancel-campaign-btn. Campaign statuses: scheduled, executing, sent, cancelled, failed. The campaign scheduler background task runs every 60s checking for due campaigns.

mocked_apis.note: Resend is in sandbox mode - actual campaign emails won't be delivered to non-verified addresses. This is expected behavior for testing.
